name: casefile
description: Casefile — inspect an agent skill, plugin, or marketplace before you install it, without executing it.

plugins.name: casefile
plugins.description: Teach your coding agent to run a Casefile static scan over a skill, plugin, or marketplace directory before installing it. Reads the text or JSON report, ties every finding to a file and line, explains findings as review signals rather than verdicts, and offers lock/verify for drift on reviewed artifacts. Never executes the artifact and never installs anything without asking.
